cases.purpose: Verify psmisc signal spellings, -s/--signal, usage status 1, and the psmisc options -l -q -w -I -r -g -y -o -v. Uses an absent process name and never intends a delivery.
cases.oracle: psmisc killall: a real signal against an absent name exits 1, usage and unknown signals exit 1, -usr1 is a user filter, and -l -q -w -I -r -g -y -o -v are accepted.
cases.comparison: Exact stdout and status; diagnostics are checked within the script.

files.body.sh:
check_valid() {
  killall "$@" t119_no_such_process >/dev/null 2>&1
  rc=$?
  if [[ $rc != 1 ]]; then echo "valid signal failed: $* rc=$rc"; exit 1; fi
}
check_error() {
  killall "$@" >out 2>err
  rc=$?
  if [[ $rc != 1 || ! -s err ]]; then echo "usage failed: $* rc=$rc"; exit 1; fi
}
check_absent() {
  killall "$@" t119_no_such_process >out 2>err
  rc=$?
  if [[ $rc != 1 ]] || ! [[ $(<err) == *"no process found"* ]]; then
    echo "absent name failed: $* rc=$rc"; exit 1
  fi
}
for s in HUP SIGUSR1 10; do
  check_valid "-$s"
  check_valid -s "$s"
  check_valid --signal "$s"
done
check_valid -sHUP
check_valid --signal=USR1
check_valid -e
check_valid --exact
killall -usr1 t119_no_such_process >out 2>err
rc=$?
if [[ $rc != 1 ]] || ! [[ $(<err) == *"Cannot find user sr1"* ]]; then
  echo "user filter failed: -usr1 rc=$rc"; exit 1
fi
for s in usr1 sIgUsR1; do
  check_error -s "$s" t119_no_such_process
  check_error --signal "$s" t119_no_such_process
done
check_error -sIgUsR1 t119_no_such_process
check_error --bogus t119_no_such_process
check_error -s BOGUS t119_no_such_process
check_absent -s 0
check_error --signal=999999999999999999999 t119_no_such_process
check_error -999999999999999999999 t119_no_such_process
check_error -s
check_error --signal
check_error
killall -l >out 2>err
rc=$?
if [[ $rc != 0 ]] || ! [[ $(<out) == *HUP* ]]; then
  echo "list failed: rc=$rc"; exit 1
fi
killall -q t119_no_such_process >out 2>err
rc=$?
if [[ $rc != 1 || -s err || -s out ]]; then
  echo "quiet failed: rc=$rc"; exit 1
fi
for opt in -v -w -I -r -g; do
  check_absent "$opt"
done
check_absent -y 1h
check_absent -o 1h
echo parser-ok
